item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
New: Saved Setups. Save your whole look under a name, switch between setups from the menu bar, and link one to your displays or to the laptop screen.

New: four built-in Starters in Settings, with pictures of how each one looks, to use as a starting point.

New: Peek. The tab bar can rest as thin colored slivers or icons and rise from behind the window when you reach for it.

New: Bookmarks, a slim deck of colored tabs along the window's edge.

New: Settings is now a sidebar window with Style, Peek, Bubbles, Mouse and Keyboard and Rules pages and a live preview. Each style remembers its own options.

Improved: choose where the tab bar sits along the window's edge, and tab bars now stay clear of the window's rounded corners.

Fixed: groups survive the lock screen, and closed windows leave their groups again.
